svg.title: Alpha Analyst — Ticker in, cited investment memo out.
svg.text: Ticker in, cited investment memo out.
A LangGraph research agent that pulls market data, news and SEC 10-K
evidence, drafts an investment memo where every factual sentence cites a
numbered source, then runs a claim-level grounding check before it ships.
